title: Amazon Affiliate & Pinterest Growth Engine (39.5k+ Monthly Views)
summary: Active Amazon Associates affiliate pipeline scaled to 39,500+ organic monthly views on Pinterest through disciplined visual SEO, high-CTR vertical pin design, and keyword targeting.
problem: Generating non-paid consumer traffic to Amazon affiliate products without an ad budget requires systematic visual SEO, niche product hunting, and high-conversion pin creative batching.
whatIDid: Launched and scaled the brand channel @cozynook_finds (Budget Tech & Home Finds) to 39,500+ organic monthly views with $0 ad spend.
Engineered high-converting 2:3 vertical pin creatives (1000x1500px) featuring benefit-driven headline typography, product feature overlays, and clear consumer hooks.
Researched high-intent seasonal and evergreen products across Amazon (Halloween home decor, desk setups, aesthetic gadgets) and integrated compliant Amazon Associates tracking links.
Built a structured content planning and scheduling spreadsheet tracking pin IDs, target keywords, publication schedules, outbound clicks, and conversion rates.
result: Scaled channel discovery to 39,500+ monthly views and active outbound clicks to Amazon with 100% organic search traffic.
